catalog.name: BarnWall
catalog.description: Keeps animals out of your camp. Corners join on their own.

catalog.name: WallWindow
catalog.description: A wall with a window.

catalog.name: WallDoorClosed
catalog.description: A door in the wall: E opens and shuts it.

catalog.name: WallDoorway
catalog.description: An open gap in the wall to walk through.

catalog.name: WallOpenSide
catalog.description: No collision and not seen outside build mode: leave a side of a smithy or market stall open and it still counts as a building (and gets its roof).

catalog.name: Fence
catalog.description: A post-and-rail fence: pens and fields. Keeps animals in or out, but doesn't make a room.

catalog.name: Barricade
catalog.description: Sharpened stakes lashed to a rail: a sturdy barrier against what comes out of the mist. Doesn't make a room.

catalog.name: Gate
catalog.description: A braced double gate between two posts, for a way through the barricades: it opens for Miko and the villagers and stays shut against monsters, who have to break it down. Doesn't make a room.

catalog.name: PlankGate
catalog.description: A battened double gate between two posts, for a way through the barricades: it opens for Miko and the villagers and stays shut against monsters, who have to break it down. Doesn't make a room.

catalog.name: BrokenWall
catalog.description: A barn wall gone to ruin: split boards and a cracked footing. Still keeps things out.

catalog.name: PlankWall
catalog.description: Plain vertical planks on a stone footing.

catalog.name: DarkPlankWall
catalog.description: Dark, weathered planks.

catalog.name: LatticeWall

catalog.name: PlasterWall

catalog.name: FieldstoneWall

catalog.name: ShojiWall
catalog.description: Paper panes in a wooden grid: lets the light through.

catalog.name: BarredWindowWall

catalog.name: ShutterWindowWall

catalog.name: BannerWall

catalog.name: PlasterStoneWall

catalog.name: BrokenPlasterWall

catalog.name: Fireplace
catalog.description: A stone hearth for a house, its back against a wall. The villagers light it each evening (4 wood) and it burns till morning. In winter, without one burning, whoever sleeps in the house sleeps cold. Cook at it too (E).

catalog.name: Bonfire
catalog.description: Cook food (E). Warms and lights nearby tiles.

catalog.name: Bedroll
catalog.description: Sleep out in the field (Z). Rest faster, wake rested.

catalog.name: LeafBed
catalog.description: A frame of poles and leaves to sleep on (Z).

catalog.name: WoodenBed
catalog.description: Sleep through the night here (Z). Indoors only; best rest.

catalog.name: Cellar
catalog.description: A cellar's doors, set in the ground outside. Keeps 100 of the village's food cold, where it spoils a quarter as fast. E to go down. One to a village: expand it (U at its doors) for a bigger room that keeps more.

catalog.name: Chest
catalog.description: Stores resources and items, shared anywhere in the village. Raises your limits. Double in a storage house.

catalog.name: TownBanner
catalog.description: Founds the village: a square of land around it where chests are shared. E beside it to grow the village.

catalog.name: TeleportCrystal
catalog.description: Travel between crystals (E). Place it 10 to 26 away from the nearest other crystal. Works anywhere.

catalog.name: RabbitHole
catalog.description: A burrow in the wilds, where rabbits live.

catalog.name: CleansingCrystal
catalog.description: Clears the mist round it (7 across), so you can hold ground deep in the mist. Not strong enough for strong mist.

catalog.name: FishingDock
catalog.description: A dock by the water for fishing, all year round (slower in winter). With a rod in your bag, E casts a line. Villagers set to fish work it. One to begin with, one more each time the village grows.

catalog.name: FarmPlot
catalog.description: Grows potatoes. Comes sown; dig them up with E when ripe (about two days), and plant a potato to grow more.

catalog.name: TallTorch
catalog.description: Lights the night round it. Burns one night (it's lit when placed); light it again at dusk for 1 wood and 1 stone.

catalog.name: Torch
catalog.description: Lights the night round it. Burns one night (it's lit when placed); light it again at dusk for 1 wood and 1 stone.

catalog.name: LumberingSign
catalog.description: Marks a lumbering area (7 round it): villagers fell trees only inside one, and plant them again.

catalog.name: MiningSign
catalog.description: Marks a mining area (7 round it): villagers mine rocks only inside one.

catalog.name: RabbitPen
catalog.description: A fenced patch of hay for rabbits grabbed in the wild (E). Two or more breed one more a day, up to 6; E with none in hand butchers one for 2 raw meat.

catalog.name: ToolWorkbench
catalog.description: Crafts tools for the villagers, bags, wooden gear and cloth, spins cotton into fibre, and strings the crystal necklace. One to a village; a second once it has grown twice.

catalog.name: AlchemyWorkbench
catalog.description: Makes bottles, potions (HP, mana) and accessories (rings, charms). One to a village; a second once it has grown twice.

catalog.name: CookingWorkbench
catalog.description: A kitchen: bakes bread and cooks carrot stew (skilled cooks only), which leave a buff. One to a village; a second once it has grown twice.
